name: Open Source Summit Europe 2026
cost: Typically ~$700–1,100; academic rate ~$250; in person only
studentAngle: Academic pass tier. The 2026 scholarship (closed Sep 7) and travel fund (closed Aug 19) are shut; for a funded LF trip this year, see Open Source Summit Japan.
what: The Linux Foundation's umbrella conference: LinuxCon, Embedded Linux Conference, Open AI + Data, security and cloud. It's co-located with Linux Plumbers (Oct 5–7) and is the place to meet the maintainers of the projects you use.

name: TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026

studentAngle: Volunteer program (free access for shifts); the side-event ecosystem is where students actually go
what: The largest crypto/Web3 conference in the world (~25,000 people, 160 countries). Founders, VCs, exchanges. Worth it only if you're building in crypto; the free side events and hackathons are the real student value.

name: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
cost: Attendee/founder passes ~$1,000–3,000; Student Pass tier is cheapest (verified against .edu/enrolment); 15% off for groups of 4+
studentAngle: Student Pass; Startup Battlefield 200 for early-stage founders (free exhibit space if selected)
what: The startup-media conference: Startup Battlefield pitch competition, VC panels, Expo Hall. Good for founders and startup-curious students; not a developer conference.

name: PyTorch Conference 2026
cost: Students and researchers $249; in person only
studentAngle: Student rate only; the 2026 registration scholarship (closed Sep 6) and travel fund (closed Aug 23) are shut
what: The PyTorch Foundation's annual conference on model training, compilers and inference. The new AGNTCon + MCPCon (agents and Model Context Protocol) runs Oct 22–23 at the same venue.

name: Grace Hopper Celebration 2026
cost: Student/academic tickets are a fraction of the industry rate (historically ~$400–600 vs $1,500+)
studentAngle: GHC Scholarships (registration + travel + hotel + meals): 2026 round closed; interest form open for 2027. Kamala Scholars (Black/Latine students) closed Sep 8, 2026. Employers (Citadel, etc.) also run GHC travel grants.
what: The largest gathering of women in computing (~30,000). The Expo/career fair is the draw: 700+ companies interviewing on-site for internships and new-grad roles. Bring résumés.

name: GitHub Universe 2026
cost: In-person ~$1,000+; virtual track free
studentAngle: Free virtual; GitHub Campus Experts sometimes get in-person passes
what: GitHub's flagship event: Copilot/agents, open-source, security. The virtual track is full-featured.

name: Devcon 8 (Ethereum) 2026
cost: General admission $499 (ETH) / $999 (card); Indian students $25 (application); India residents $149 (Aadhaar check). Prices include 18% GST.
studentAngle: $25 Indian-student ticket; free side events and hackathons all through Devcon week
register: On sale now at devcon.org/tickets. Student applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.
what: The Ethereum Foundation's annual global gathering, in India for the first time. Core devs, cryptography, L2s, zero-knowledge, plus a week of community events. If you're anywhere near Mumbai in November and remotely interested in Web3, this is the year.

name: Hackaday Supercon 2026
cost: $296 + fees (2026 regular price)
what: Hackaday's hardware-hacker conference: badge hacking, talks on electronics, reverse engineering. Tiny and beloved. 2026 is the tenth edition: Friday badge-hacking at Supplyframe HQ, then Sat–Sun talks at the larger ArtCenter South Campus. Every past Supercon sold out.

name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon NA 2026
cost: Academic $275 All-Access / $200 KubeCon-only (full-time students, proof required); individual from $899
studentAngle: Dan Kohn Scholarship: free All-Access pass (no travel) for underrepresented or need-based applicants. Apply by Oct 4, 2026 (11:59 pm MT). The CNCF Travel Fund closed Sep 13. In person only; talks go up on YouTube afterwards.
what: The Kubernetes/cloud-native mothership (~10,000 people). Maintainer tracks, project pavilion, huge sponsor floor hiring for infra roles.

name: Web Summit 2026
cost: €895–2,450 general; startup (ALPHA) packages; Women in Tech discounted tickets
studentAngle: Volunteer program: work shifts, get a pass; apply months ahead
what: A 70,000-person startup mega-conference. Networking density is unmatched; content is shallow. If you're a student, volunteer. Do not pay full price.

name: Adobe MAX 2026
cost: Full pass ~$1,895; student/educator rate much lower; online option
what: The creativity conference, with Photoshop/Premiere/Firefly launches, hands-on labs and "Sneaks". For design, film and creative-tech students.

name: Microsoft Ignite 2026
cost: In-person ~$2,000+; online free (keynotes, selected sessions)
what: Microsoft's IT/cloud/AI conference for practitioners, covering Azure, Copilot and security. Watch online; don't fly for it as a student.

name: Slush 2026
cost: Attendee tickets ~€500+; founder tickets application-based
studentAngle: Slush Volunteer program (~2,000 volunteers, mostly students, get access); Slush is itself student-run
what: Europe's founder-focused conference, run by students. Highest signal-to-noise of the big startup events; dark, loud, Nordic.

name: AWS re:Invent 2026
cost: Full pass ~$2,099; virtual free (keynotes + Innovation Talks live; most sessions on-demand within 48 h)
studentAngle: Free virtual; AWS Educate/Community Builders occasionally sponsor
what: The biggest cloud conference (50,000+). Certification exams on-site, hundreds of hands-on labs. As a student, attend virtually.

name: GITEX Global 2026
cost: Visitor passes historically AED 100–500; conference passes more
studentAngle: Universities often get group/student passes; Expand North Star is the startup side
visa: UAE e-visa (2–5 working days, via airline, hotel or sponsor). Don't count on visa-on-arrival unless you hold a US Green Card or UK/EU residence permit
what: MENA's biggest tech expo (200,000 attendees, 6,800 exhibitors), held at Expo City for the first time. Close to India, easy visa, lots of Indian companies exhibiting.

name: Open Source Summit Japan 2026
studentAngle: LF Travel Fund (economy flights, hotel, airport transfers; reimbursed after the event): apply by Oct 19, 2026. Registration scholarship (free pass): apply by Nov 2, 2026. Both are for underrepresented groups or open-source contributors without employer funding.
visa: Japan visa via VFS (~5 working days)
what: The Linux Foundation's Asia-Pacific open-source summit (with Open Compute and AI tracks).

name: 40C3: Chaos Communication Congress

register: Ticket presale via events.ccc.de; it historically sells out in a lottery/voucher system, so watch from ~Oct

name: CES 2027

studentAngle: Students at engineering/business programs usually qualify if they show university affiliation; no formal scholarship
what: The world's biggest consumer-tech show (Sony is skipping 2027). AI, robotics, EVs, health tech. Register before Nov 30 for the cheap pass.

name: FOSDEM 2027
cost: Free
studentAngle: Free; hundreds of dev-room talks; every project stand wants contributors
what: The largest free open-source developer meeting (8,000+ people, 800+ talks). Chaotic, cold, wonderful. If you are in Europe in January, go.

name: Web Summit Qatar 2027
studentAngle: Volunteer program; Qatar Foundation students get passes
visa: None needed: visa-free for 30 days with a return ticket and hotel booking (register on Hayya)
what: Web Summit's Middle East edition. Easier visa than Lisbon, smaller crowd, lots of Gulf VC.

name: ETHDenver 2027
cost: Free ticket via application
studentAngle: Free; BUIDLathon hackathon with large bounties; BUIDLWeek camps before

studentAngle: 4YFN (Four Years From Now) startup hall sometimes runs student/university passes; no general scholarship
what: The biggest connectivity show (100,000+): phones, 5G/6G, satellites, telecom AI.

name: SXSW 2027

studentAngle: Student badges; volunteer program (shifts for badge)

what: The AI-industry keynote of the year, plus hundreds of technical sessions and hands-on DLI labs. For most students, attending virtually is enough.

name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027
studentAngle: Academic pricing; Dan Kohn scholarship; virtual
what: European KubeCon. Same value as NA with easier visa.

name: TOKEN2049 Dubai 2027
visa: UAE e-visa (2–5 working days). Don't count on visa-on-arrival unless you hold a US Green Card or UK/EU residence permit
what: The Dubai edition of TOKEN2049. Its 2026 edition was pushed to April 2027.

name: Google Cloud Next 2027
studentAngle: Keynotes streamed free; Google Developer Groups sometimes distribute passes
what: Google's cloud/AI conference. Watch the keynote; skip the flight.

studentAngle: Free livestream; I/O Extended meetups run by GDGs in every Indian city (May–Jul)

what: Web Summit's North American edition since 2025, and the successor to Collision (Toronto).

what: Microsoft's developer conference (Copilot/agents, Azure AI, Windows, GitHub).

what: Europe's consumer-electronics show; public can walk the halls.

visa: Canada visitor visa (IRCC's processing estimate for applicants in India: 32 days in Sep 2026; check the current figure when you apply)
what: The Rust community's annual conference: talks and workshops from compiler, library and industry developers.

cost: Public tickets ~¥2,500–3,500

what: The C++ conference; the 2026 edition (Sep) has passed.

what: The largest gathering of women in computing. The career fair is the main draw.

name: OpenAI DevDay 2027

what: OpenAI's one-day developer conference: API and model launches; in-person seats go to selected applicants.

what: KubeCon's North American edition: maintainer tracks, the project pavilion and a sponsor floor hiring for infra roles.

name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon India 2027

what: The second big NLP conference of the year (with ACL). Findings papers, workshops, industry track.

name: FOCS 2026

name: ACM CCS 2026
what: The ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security, one of the top security venues along with IEEE S&P and USENIX Security.

name: NeurIPS 2026
cost: Student registration a few hundred USD (early rates end Oct 31, 2026); virtual cheaper
studentAngle: Financial Assistance + Volunteer applications close Oct 6, 2026, 23:59 AoE (decisions by Oct 14 for FA, Oct 20 for volunteers). FA = free registration + prepaid hotel; flights, meals and local transport are not covered, so pair it with ANRF ITS for airfare. FA can also cover a virtual-only registration. Volunteers pay registration upfront and are refunded after their shifts; no hotel. Volunteering is open for Sydney and Atlanta now; Paris opens later. Pick the venue you can realistically reach
visa: Australia visitor visa (subclass 600, apply 2+ months ahead) · US B1/B2 for Atlanta · Schengen for Paris
what: The largest ML research conference. Sydney is the main venue; Atlanta and Paris are official satellites. Pick the one whose visa you can get before December.

name: AGU Fall Meeting 2026
what: The American Geophysical Union's annual meeting, covering earth, ocean, atmospheric, planetary and space science.

name: CODS 2026
studentAngle: Student rate; author travel grants by Oct 9
what: ACM India's data science and data management conference (called CODS-COMAD 2018–2024), with a main track, an AI for Biology track and a Young Researchers' Symposium.

name: IndoML 2026
cost: Regular registration ₹15,000 (faculty, postdocs, industry). Students come in through the two forums below: ₹2,500 for the Graduate Forum, a discounted rate for the Undergraduate Forum
studentAngle: Both forums have closed for 2026. Undergraduate Forum (3rd/4th-year UG, 5th-year dual degree): applications closed Sep 15, results Oct 30; accepted posters get discounted registration + partial travel/funding support. Graduate Forum (MTech/MS/PhD students at Indian institutions working in AI/ML): applications closed Aug 31, results Oct 18; ₹2,500 fee, poster/spotlight slots, support toward registration, 3AC train travel (₹2,000–7,500 depending on where you travel from), meals and stay; ₹50,000 in prizes for the top 5
what: The Indian Symposium on Machine Learning, with tutorials by top researchers, student poster sessions and career panels. The best entry-level ML research event in India.

name: ICON 2026
what: The 22nd International Conference on Natural Language Processing, the flagship conference of the NLP Association of India (NLPAI); proceedings go to the ACL Anthology.

name: ICVGIP 2026
what: India's main computer vision / graphics conference (17th edition), ACM ICPS proceedings.

name: ACM India Annual Event 2027
what: ACM India's celebration of the computing ecosystem: Turing/ACM Fellow talks, doctoral dissertation and early-career awards, and student panels.

visa: Canada visitor visa. AAAI issues invitation letters only to paid registrants, so register and apply as early as you can (main-track authors hear on Nov 30, about 11 weeks before the conference). IRCC's posted processing time for India was 32 days in late Sep 2026

name: NCC 2027

name: AISTATS 2027

name: CHI 2027

name: NSDI 2027

name: IEEE S&P 2027

name: ICRA 2027

what: The flagship robotics conference (with IROS).

name: ISCA 2027

name: STOC 2027

name: SIGGRAPH Asia 2027
